agent_types.CoordinatorAgent: Manages overall system activities and communication between agents.
agent_types.CommunicationAgent: Facilitates information exchange and protocol adherence between different agents.
agent_types.DataAgent: Gathers and processes data required for system operations.
agent_types.DecisionAgent: Analyzes data and determines actions or strategies for system goals.
agent_types.MonitoringAgent: Observes and evaluates system performance and agent activities.
agent_types.ResourceAgent: Allocates necessary resources and coordinates shared utilities within the system.
agent_types.SecurityAgent: Ensures system integrity and protects against unauthorized access or threats.
